prompts.title: Python OOP Learning Assistant
prompts.template:
Explain [topic] to me as a [skill level] learner.

Start with a simple explanation.

Then provide:
• Real-world analogy
• Step-by-step explanation
• Syntax (if applicable)
• Practical example
• Common mistakes
• Best practices
• Interview questions
• Practice exercise

Present everything in [format].

prompts.title: Explain a concept simply
prompts.template: Explain [topic] to me like I'm at a [skill level] level. Use a [format] format and include one real-world example.

prompts.title: Turn notes into a study plan
prompts.template:
Here are my raw notes on [topic]:

[notes]

Turn this into a structured [duration] study plan with daily goals.

prompts.title: Debug this code
prompts.template:
I'm getting this error in [language]:

[error]

Here's the relevant code:

[code]

Explain what's wrong and how to fix it.

prompts.title: Compare two options
prompts.template: Compare [option a] and [option b] for [use case]. Give me a short pros/cons list and a recommendation.
